name: Dane Street
desc:
Group Health Customer Service Representative | $15.00 - $19.00/hr | Phone and Email Heavy, Case Management
Industry: Healthcare | Billing & Admin
 What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Dane Street is a national Independent Medical Examination and Peer Review company processing over 200,000 insurance claims annually for Workers' Compensation, Disability, Auto, and Group Health insurance carriers. As a Group Health CSR, you are the central connection point between Dane Street's clients, its network of physician reviewers, and internal operations teams. Your job is to move insurance claim cases through the review process accurately and on time.
 
Key responsibilities from the posting:
Intake new cases, review and verify information, and draft cases into Dane Street's internal system, AccessDS
Work with clients to obtain any missing documentation needed to process a claim
Sort, organize, and create medical document listings when required by the client
Monitor, process, and track cases to ensure deadlines are met
Assign and schedule cases to physicians based on location, availability, jurisdictional requirements, and client-specific guidelines
Verify that assigned physicians have no conflict of interest with their case assignments
Update clients frequently on case status and progress
Communicate with clients and physicians' offices by phone and email throughout each case

This role involves substantial daily communication with both clients and physicians' offices via phone and email, alongside consistent computer-based case management work. You are coordinating a medical review process, not providing direct patient care, but the accuracy and timeliness of your work directly affects insurance claim outcomes.
assessment: After an initial phone screen, candidates complete a one-way video interview through a third-party platform, answering up to five recorded questions with time limits ranging from 30 seconds to 90 seconds per question.
wage: $15.00 to $19.00/hr depending on experience, education, and skills.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Associate's degree preferred, not required.
 Required Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in an administrative or clerical role in a business office environment.
 Preferred Experience:
Healthcare environment experience such as a medical office or insurance claims
 Required Skills:
Excellent computer skills, Apple OS, Google Chrome, and Gmail preferred
Strong written and verbal communication, including comfort speaking with clients, claimants, and physician offices
Ability to maintain focus and attention to detail in a fast-paced environment
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks with quickly changing priorities
 Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with at least 1 year of administrative or clerical experience who is comfortable communicating professionally with both business clients and medical professionals
People who are organized, deadline-driven, and can track multiple active cases simultaneously
Participants who want Apple equipment provided and a media stipend for their remote setup
Anyone interested in healthcare claims and insurance review as a long-term career direction
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without at least 1 year of office administrative or clerical experience
Participants who prefer minimal phone and email interaction, since this role involves substantial daily communication on both channels
Anyone who needs a quick hire timeline, since CSR roles at this company average 40 days from application to offer
 Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Case management
Insurance claims processing
Medical document management
Physician scheduling
Client communication
Healthcare administrative support
Independent medical review
Workers' compensation and group health
AccessDS or healthcare case management systems
Deadline-driven case tracking
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 After applying, expect an initial phone screen with a recruiter. Within 48 hours of the phone screen, candidates are sent a link to complete a one-way recorded video interview through a third-party platform. The video interview consists of up to five questions with time limits ranging from 30 seconds to 90 seconds per answer. The overall process averages 40 days from application to offer for CSR roles. Participants should be prepared to stay patient and continue applying elsewhere during the wait.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Discuss a time when you provided excellent customer service.
Provide an example of when it was necessary to ensure you completed a task in a timely manner.
Tell me about your experience managing multiple tasks or cases with competing deadlines.
How do you stay organized when tracking multiple active files or cases at the same time?
other:
Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided, which is a real differentiator from most remote roles in the database where the participant supplies their own setup.

The one-way video interview step is worth preparing participants for specifically, since it can feel unfamiliar compared to a live conversation. They record their answers alone, with strict time limits, and cannot re-record. Practice answering timed questions beforehand so the format does not catch them off guard.

The 40-day average hiring timeline for CSR roles is the longest in the database. This is not a fast-moving process. Encourage participants to keep applying elsewhere rather than waiting exclusively on Dane Street, and set expectations clearly so they are not discouraged when weeks pass without an offer.

Career Pathway: Group Health CSR → Senior CSR → CSR Team Lead → CSR Supervisor → Group Health Operations Manager
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
